exposure: pathogenic variants in the SMAD3 gene
outcome: Cardiovascular abnormalities (including mitral valve disease, aortic disease, aortic aneurysms and dissections)
cohort: A familial cohort of 19 patients affected by Loeys-Dietz syndrome type III, identified through systematic genetic screening and phenotypic screening of direct descendants.
finding: The study found an 84% prevalence of cardiovascular abnormalities and significant intrafamilial phenotypic variability in LDS III patients, with mitral valve disease being the predominant cardiovascular issue and 92% of patients over 18 years of age having osteoarthritis.
